column1: # Full HID tap manifest — every path a report can leave the host by.
# Replaces the single-tap manifest in taps.tsv, whose one active entry
# (UniversalHIDService.send) is why Device Hub's tap was never captured: the
# Indigo button/digitizer/scroll sockets were never bound at all, so a capture
# that saw no digitizer traffic could not distinguish "Device Hub did not send
# one" from "we were not listening".
# xpc_remote_connection_send_message* was the recommended universal choke
# point. It is NOT usable here: it does not resolve by name under lldb on this
# host (libxpc exports xpc_connection_send_message and its two reply variants
# and nothing for the remote-connection family), so the tap has to sit one
# level up, in CoreDevice.framework, which carries full symbols. These nine
# entry points are the complete set of CoreDevice HID sends.
#   label <TAB> module <TAB> mangled symbol <TAB> json spec
# --- UniversalHID: the report path (tap, swipe, key, scroll, abs-pointer) ---
uhid_send_id
uhid_send_u64
uhid_send_ext
# --- Indigo: the event path. Never bound before this manifest. -------------
indigo_digitizer
indigo_digitizer_cg
indigo_button
indigo_button_typed
indigo_scroll
indigo_vendor
indigo_keyboard
